page.overview:
Who is The Cerato?

The Cerato is a Ceratosaurus individual featured in Jurassic Park III. It went up to the group of survivors. Realizing that it was in Spinosaurus territory, it was driven away and emerged back into the forest.

The Cerato is shown to have a red upper body and head, and a light tan lower body. It has black stripes running down from the neck to the tail. It has a distinct horn on the tip of its head, and yellow eyes with black pupils. Its front teeth stick out of its upper jaw, while the lower set of teeth is tucked behind the upper jaw. According to the official Jurassic Park III Comparative Size Chart, The Cerato measured in at 12 feet (3.65 meters) tall and 30.5 feet (9.29 meters) long.

Not much can be said about The Cerato's behavior, but it is shown around Asset 87's territory which might suggest that it was not scared of going near dangerous areas. It was not afraid of approaching four humans, which could mean it was defensive or just curious.

This Ceratosaurus was encountered by Dr. Alan Grant and the Kirby family along a riverbank on Isla Sorna when they were digging through piles of Spinosaurus dung in search of a satellite phone. The dinosaur intended to attack them but, instead, walked away and spared the survivors after sniffing the dung pile. It was not only deterred because of its stench, but also the realization of being in Spinosaurus territory due to recognition of the scent from the dung/droppings.
